source.title: Use of SGLT2 Inhibitors in the Management of Patients With Heart Failure Pocket Guide: Transformation of Heart Failure Care: SGLT2is as the New Pillar in Heart Failure
source.source_type: ACC clinical practice pocket guide / secondary clinical-policy summary

extraction_limitations: This is a secondary practice document, not primary literature. Atoms represent what the ACC pocket guide reports; they do not convert the underlying trials or guidelines into primary-study evidence.

The guide does not contain a formal bibliography. It names three clinical policies and gives one full bibliographic citation; remaining bibliographic metadata were resolved separately for the references artifact.

The guide was produced in 2024. A 2026 ACC HFpEF Expert Consensus Decision Pathway now updates the 2023 HFpEF document cited by the guide, so HFpEF-specific recommendations should be checked against current policy before clinical use.
No independent human verification was performed in this extraction run; atoms remain marked needs_review.
schema_gaps: The current LiteratureAtom schema has no dedicated guideline_recommendation or clinical_practice_recommendation atom kind. Recommendation, dosing, contraindication, caution, and workflow assertions were therefore represented primarily as atom_kind=other with descriptive tags and source-appropriate context.

The schema has no dedicated field for guideline class of recommendation or evidence grade; displayed COR values were preserved in canonical statements, exposure details, and tags rather than invented as structured evidence metadata.
